title: FitTrack Ad From Supplied Screenshots
tests: Uses supplied app screenshots faithfully in a finished landscape ad rather than inventing replacement screens.

faults.what: The supplied screenshots are visibly distorted rather than faithfully preserved: small UI labels and numbers become garbled, and the workout heading appears as 'Workoot'. The screens retain their general layouts but are not reliably readable.

judge.summary: The ad has a clean widescreen layout, the correct screen sequence, and a clear FitTrack ending, but distorted screenshot text requires a redo.

must_haves.item: The final video is 10 seconds long and landscape 16:9.
must_haves.why: The reported duration is 10.1 seconds, effectively the requested length, and the frames are landscape 16:9.

must_haves.item: The supplied FitTrack home screenshot appears before the supplied workout screenshot.
must_haves.why: The blue home-screen layout appears at 1.3 seconds, followed by the green workout-screen layout.

must_haves.item: Both screenshots remain recognizable and readable, without invented replacement UI.
must_haves.why: Their overall layouts are recognizable, but the UI text is visibly regenerated and garbled rather than faithfully retained.
The ending frame prominently displays the correctly spelled app name.

must_haves.item: An upbeat instrumental track is audible, with no voiceover.
must_haves.why: The audio transcription indicates music and no speech, but it does not establish whether the music has an upbeat instrumental beat.
